home.title: Give your take on an anime
home.intro: Search for an anime you have watched, pick the word that fits best for each criterion, then send your review on GitHub. You need a GitHub account.
whole.title: You are rating the whole work
whole.text: Not one season, not one arc: the anime as a whole, sequels included. We know seasons can be very different. But the goal is to help people discover other anime, not a particular season. Thanks for keeping this in mind!
whole.short: Rate the whole work, all seasons and arcs included.

section.other.title: Others

criteria.art_direction.label: Art direction
criteria.art_direction.desc: Visual identity: composition, colours, light, backgrounds and visual effects.
criteria.three_d_usage.label: 3D usage
criteria.three_d_usage.desc: Place and weight of elements made in three dimensions.
criteria.character_design.label: Character design
criteria.character_design.desc: Simplicity, precision, level of detail and distinctiveness of the characters.
criteria.animation.label: Animation
criteria.animation.desc: Fluidity, timing, transitions and execution of movement across the whole work.
criteria.mood.label: Mood
criteria.mood.desc: Overall brightness of the atmosphere, regardless of emotional intensity.
criteria.pacing.label: Pacing
criteria.pacing.desc: Speed of progression, from contemplative to frenetic.
criteria.narrative_complexity.label: Narrative complexity
criteria.narrative_complexity.desc: Complexity of the plot, its branches and its reveals.
criteria.emotional_intensity.label: Emotional intensity
criteria.emotional_intensity.desc: How strongly the work calls on emotions.
criteria.sexualization.label: Sexualization
criteria.sexualization.desc: Staging that dwells on bodies in a suggestive way: lingering camera angles, exaggerated physics, suggestive poses or situations. Does not count: romance, kissing, non-suggestive nudity, or nods to fans. Used only as a filter.
mood.title: Moods
mood.desc: Which moods match the overall atmosphere of the work? Several answers possible (3–4 advised).

dialog.multi.text: You can rate several anime and send them all in one suggestion. If it is too long for a link, you will paste the text into GitHub yourself (one click copies it). Continue?

help.title: What does “Mixed feelings” mean?
help.p1: You pick the level that feels most accurate. “Mixed feelings” simply means you are not sure: your choice is never altered.
help.p2: What changes is its influence: a mixed answer weighs half as much in the results as a confident one.
help.p3: Only tick it when you truly doubt. If you have no opinion at all, choose “No opinion”.
help.formula: Reviews are combined with a weighted median (weight 1 if confident, 0.5 if mixed): levels are sorted, weights are added up, and the level that reaches half of the total weight wins. Level 5 stays 5: only its weight changes.
